omicsApp

Shiny web interface for multi-omics analysis, built on omicsCore.

Install 

# Install dependencies first
devtools::install_local("path/to/omicsCore")
devtools::install_local("path/to/omicsApp")

Launch 

omicsApp::launch()

Status

Phase 0 — skeleton. The UI modules and server logic will be implemented in Phase 2.
